tickerText: [TENNIS] Nitto ATP Finals round-robin play opens Sunday in Turin as top seed Alexander Zverev faces Rafael Jodar and Ben Shelton meets Arthur Fils, with Saturday's final Inalpi Arena practice day for ticket holders • [SQUASH] Pittsburgh Open PSA Silver semifinals Saturday pair No. 1 Joel Makin with Leonel Cardenas and pit Finnlay Withington against Marwan ElShorbagy before Sunday's $96,000 final • [BADMINTON] Kumamoto Masters Japan Super 500 semifinals on Nov 14 advanced Alwi Farhan past Lakshya Sen and set Koki Watanabe against Kunlavut Vitidsarn with Miyazaki and Yamaguchi into women's title matches • [PICKLEBALL] Amateur registration closes Friday for the Nov 16–22 Proton Daytona Beach Open at Pictona as all five pro draws are set for a 1,000-point week with more than $1 million in payouts • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Contender Istanbul's Nov 14 slate runs singles quarterfinals and women's doubles semis, with Russia's Evgeny Tikhonov and Maria Panfilova meeting Connor Green and Anna Hursey in the mixed doubles final

newsItems.title: Turin Opens Sunday
newsItems.excerpt: The Nitto ATP Finals begin Sunday at Inalpi Arena as Alexander Zverev opens against Rafael Jodar and Ben Shelton takes on Arthur Fils, while Saturday remains the last on-site practice day before eight-man round-robin play.

newsItems.title: Pittsburgh Semis Set
newsItems.excerpt: Saturday's PSA Silver semifinals at the Pittsburgh Open send top seed Joel Makin against Leonel Cardenas and Finnlay Withington against Marwan ElShorbagy after Friday's quarterfinal upsets cleared the last-eight field.

newsItems.title: Daytona Gates Open
newsItems.excerpt: Friday is the final day to register for amateur brackets at the Proton Daytona Beach Open, with pro qualifying beginning Monday Nov 16 at Pictona on a Carvana PPA Tour Open worth 1,000 points across five divisions.

newsItems.title: Istanbul Final Day
newsItems.excerpt: Saturday at WTT Contender Istanbul features men's and women's singles quarterfinals and mixed doubles medal play, including Tikhonov and Panfilova against Green and Hursey for the mixed title on a $100,000 prize week.
